header.title: How to Clean Solar Garden Lights
header.description: This guide provides a simple, step-by-step process for cleaning your solar garden lights, ensuring optimal performance and longevity. Learn how to properly clean both the solar panel and battery compartment.

steps.description: Disassemble the solar lights using the provided instructions to access the solar panels.
Clean the solar battery by removing oxidation and ensuring contact points are clear.
actions: Remove the solar battery from the light fixture.
Check for oxidation where the plastic and cell pack make contact.
Clean oxidized batteries with a small soft brush.
Clean the areas of contact with the light fixture.
Consider replacing the solar battery if it has been in use for more than a year and malfunctioning.

steps.description: Clean the solar panel monthly using a damp cloth to remove dirt and grime.
actions: Clean the solar panel at least once a month
Gently wipe down the collector panel
Remove any dust, dirt, or grime
Wipe it with a dry cloth

steps.description: Clean and dry the outer shell of the solar garden lights and then reassemble them according to the original instructions.
actions: Wipe the outer shell with a damp cloth.
Wash the outer shell in a sink (if made of glass or plastic).
Re-assemble the light fixture according to the solar garden light instructions.
steps.part: Outer shell of the solar garden lights
